detail.longDescription: A vCluster tenant can see pseudo-nodes while its pods run on your host nodes beside other workloads. That makes Shared Nodes a control-plane boundary, not a host boundary. Dedicated Nodes changes placement; Private Nodes moves the workers, CNI and CSI to the tenant. The post walks through the checks. https:// coresolutions.ltd/blog/vcluste r-isolation-where-the-syncer-stops # kubernetes # vcluster # multitenancy
